theorems.name: Submission.cbr_cidc_dilation_exists_eq_blowUp
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, ∃ X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω')) ∧ ∀ X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω') → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (ω₁ : TestFormOn (dilation a lam '' (univ : Set (Euclid P))) m), (ω₁ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) → X' ω = blowUp X a lam hlam.ne' ω₁
